953 Writ Petition No. 6766 Of 2017
 Bhagwan Bhaurao Kadam
 Versus
The State Of Maharashtra And Others

... 
 Mr. Panditrao S. Anerao, Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr. B. A. Shinde, Agp for Respondent-State.

... 
 Coram : Siddheshwar S. Thombre, J.
 Date : 6th January, 2026
 P.C.:-
1.
Heard learned Advocates for the respective parties.

2. By the present petition, the Petitioner assails the order dated 31.03.2011 passed by the learned Joint Civil Judge, Senior Division, Kandhar, District Nanded in L.A.R. No.223 of 2009, whereby reference filed by the Petitioner for enhancement of compensation was partly allowed.
3.

Considering the nature of the challenge and the reliefs sought in the petition, the Petitioner has an efficacious alternative remedy of filing an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894.
Hence, the petition deserves to be disposed of on that ground.

4. Petitioner is at liberty to file appeal under Section 54 of the 2 of 2 953-WP.6766.2017 Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
5.
In the event the Petitioner file an appeal, he shall not be entitled to claim any interest for the period from the date of filing of the present petition till the date of filing of the appeal.

6. Needless to mention that the time spent in prosecuting the present petition shall be taken into consideration while deciding the application for condonation of delay, if the Petitioner files an Bhagwan Bhaurao Kadam vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74035589/
1 appeal.
7.
